verdict.rationale: Consensus documents natural-language querying through AI-embedding semantic search that 'support[s] natural language queries'. Threads turn searches into conversations, and a research agent chains tools such as citation crawling, DOI lookup and author search. The evidence covers natural-language research questions, not operating the product as a whole (library, filters, imports, exports) through natural-language commands. missing for 10: documented natural-language control of non-search product functions (library management, filtering, import/export), independent or hands-on corroboration of conversational command handling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Semantic search, powered by AI embeddings, to capture the intent behind your question and support natural language queries.
Threads reimagines how you interact with peer-reviewed research by turning isolated searches into flowing conversations.
Consensus has evolved from a search tool into a research agent. Citation crawling, DOI lookup, author search, similar papers, and more - chained together
